cases.name: n1-default
cases.proves: Night 1 under v1.2: 240 s night, fuel decay, shades drain weak lanterns, no early win

cases.name: burnout-relight
cases.proves: Fuel 0.5 burns out at tick 30 (lantern_out, deposited 0, ever_lit), relit for 5 fireflies (relight: true, +40)

cases.name: drain
cases.proves: Wandering shade goes to the weak lantern, drains 5/s (+1/s), fuel_drain every 60 ticks, lantern_out, back to wander

cases.name: drain-pulse
cases.proves: Pulse on a draining shade: +15 total; stun ends in wander

cases.name: refuel-evict
cases.proves: Refuel back to >= 30 evicts the draining shade to the 6 m edge, no hit

cases.name: all-lit-continues
cases.proves: All 5 lit does not end the night

cases.name: dawn-win
cases.proves: 3/5 lit at dawn -> won dawn_survived, score 3x(50+99) + 3x50 = 597
